description: Retrieval test set of the TrackFlow knowledge base. Each question has ONE correct chunk, identified by (source_document, chunk_index) as produced by data/process/rag_chunking.py from docs/company-knowledge-base/. Recall@3 = share of questions whose correct chunk is among the 3 best results. `off_topic` questions have no answer in the knowledge base and are used to tune the minimum similarity score.

questions.question: A customer bought in the United States and wants to return the product in Spain. Is that return automatic?
Who pays the return shipping if the product arrived damaged in transit?
How many days does standard shipping take within the same country, and what about express?
questions.expected_section: Delivery SLA > Service types and delivery times

questions.question: What compensation does a client get if on-time deliveries fall below the committed SLA for two months in a row?
questions.expected_section: Delivery SLA > Contractual SLA and compensation

questions.question: A prospect asks us to guarantee delivery times during Black Friday. Can we promise that?
questions.expected_section: Delivery SLA > High-demand dates (no SLA guarantee)

questions.question: Which carrier best covers rural Aragón?
Which carrier gives the best rate for heavy packages shipped from Los Angeles?
questions.expected_section: Carrier Coverage > United States carriers (Los Angeles)

questions.question: Can an account manager choose which carrier a shipment goes with?
questions.expected_section: Carrier Coverage > Carrier selection and exceptions

questions.question: How much do you charge per cubic meter per month for storage in Zaragoza, and is there a free period?
questions.expected_section: Storage Pricing > Standard storage rates and long-term fee

questions.question: A client with a large volume is asking for a storage discount. Can I offer one?
questions.expected_section: Storage Pricing > Preferential rates (Miguel Torres approval)

questions.question: Can the client get an inventory aging report on their own?
